insights.title: KPI 4 not computable on demo scope

insights.title: KPI 7 not computable on demo scope
insights.detail: No NM/SM classifier was run on ContextFlow. The only NM/SM data are current labels, with no forward class to score. F1 is not estimated.

insights.title: KPI 10 not computable on demo scope
insights.detail: The 100% target needs a labelled ground truth, which the demo does not have. Candidates found by exact description only; near-duplicates are not searched.

insights.title: KPI 13 not computable on demo scope
